name: inblock-map-block
description: Gutenberg block to display an OpenStreetMap and plot items from a selected post type.
author: Inblock

scripts.build: wp-scripts build src/index.js src/view.js src/pro-edit__premium_only.js src/pro-view__premium_only.js
scripts.start: wp-scripts start src/index.js src/view.js src/pro-edit__premium_only.js src/pro-view__premium_only.js
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names assets,wordpress --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start" "npm run wordpress"
scripts.check:js: npm run lint:package && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
